{{Quote|Perhaps your way lies with the Sith... and the heart of their darkness. To recognize what strength is, and bring that strength to those that follow you... and those that defy you. The way of a Sith Lord.|[[Kreia]]|<ref name="KOTOR 2" />}}
'''Sith Lord''' was a title that was conferred on members of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith Order]] who had both considerable knowledge of and strength in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].

==History==
[[Adas]]'s title of [[Sith'ari/Legends|Sith'ari]] meant "the lord" or "[[overlord]]".<ref name="end">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref>

[[Darth Revan's Sith Empire]] granted this title to its high-ranking members, with [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] himself being the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. However, the majority of the dark-side users in Darth Revan's Sith Empire were known as [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]].<ref name="KOTOR" />

[[Tenebrae|Vitiate's]] [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] granted this title to mid-ranking Sith members, usually those who had passed their apprenticeships and were not officially controlled by other Lords. Lords of the Sith ranked above [[Overseer (Sith)|Overseers]] and below [[Darth/Legends|Darths]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

In both Darth Revan's<ref name="KOTOR" /> and Vitiate's Sith Empires, those who aspired to become Sith Lords had to train at Korriban's [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] and pass several brutal trials that tested their prowess and strength in the dark side. If they succeeded, they were admitted to the Order as new Sith Lords.<ref name="SWTOR" />

The [[New Sith]] under [[Darth Ruin/Legends|Darth Ruin]] were in power<ref name="end" /> during the [[Draggulch Period]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Sith Lords then stalked the galaxy, until the organization eventually fell to infighting, and broke into individual Sith Lords.<ref name="end" /> 

Lord [[Skere Kaan|Kaan]]'s [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] gave all Sith Lords nominal equal status among the Sith. This strategy was created to prevent the Sith from killing each other, which had been the natural order of the dark side until the formation of the Brotherhood.<ref name="Path" /> 

At the end of the [[Ruusan campaign]], Bane saw this as a violation of the natural order of the Sith and cleansed the Order by destroying Lord Kaan's Brotherhood and supplanting it with his own [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]]; two Sith, one master to embody the power and one to crave it.<ref name="Path" /> In most cases, the apprentice was trained until he or she was strong enough in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to kill his or her master, which usually took decades.<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> 

Sith Lord [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], who desired to be the sole ruling Sith, formed his [[Rule of One (Palpatine's Doctrine)|own Rule]]. To ensure he remained the sole ruler, he would betray and replace his apprentices.<ref name="BoS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>

After the Galactic Civil War, [[Darth Krayt]] abandoned the Rule of Two to rebuild the [[One Sith|Sith]], thus multiplying the population of the Sith Lords hugely, all under the rule of Darth Krayt. They then attacked the Empire after the [[Sith–Imperial War]] and ruled the galaxy.

Some female Sith such as [[Lumiya]], [[Tahiri Veila]], [[Olaris Rhea]], and [[Vestara Khai]] were styled '''Sith Lady''' rather than "Sith Lord."

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', the Sith Lord is one of the six prestige character classes which the [[Meetra Surik|player character]] can select after reaching Level 15, if he or she is leaning toward the dark side, serving as the Force-centered specialization.

A Sith Lord named [[Darth Homiiz]] was to appear in [[Dark Horse Comics|Dark Horse's]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] ''[[Jedi: Yoda]]'' but was cut from the final version.
